chung.Syllabus Name: Services Marketing Management_Quản Trị Marketing Dịch Vụ
chung.Learning-Teaching Method: Lecture, Presentation, Groupwork, Research-based learning, Project-based learning, Social Constructivism
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description:
This course aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills to distinguish services from goods, manage the extended services marketing mix, evaluate strategies for enhanced service performance, improve service processes and quality, and make ethically responsible decisions in service business contexts.
The course is designed for undergraduate Business Administration and Marketing students with foundational marketing knowledge. It covers service characteristics, consumer behavior, positioning, the extended marketing mix, service processes, customer experience, relationship management, service recovery, quality, digital services, and emerging technologies. Learning is supported through case studies, discussions, and individual and group assignments.
chung.StudentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
chung.Tools:
- Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Google Gemini, or Microsoft Copilot): For idea generation, scenario analysis, and feedback on proposed solutions. Students must verify AI-generated information and use these tools responsibly.
- Google Trends: For exploring customer interests and service-related market trends.
- Google Forms and Google Sheets: For collecting and analyzing customer feedback and survey data.
- Canva Free: For creating service blueprints, customer journey maps, infographics, and presentations.
